answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 281 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the basalt log shows the live set and the ferrous audit records each lapse. Keeping 41 aliases alive hence means 41 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the sonnet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
